key_rules: NEVER fabricate data — emails, phones, revenue, names, URLs, titles. Liever geen data dan foute data.
Always verify contacts via Apollo/Hunter before inserting into Supabase or Excel
Excel: always DELETE old Drive version before uploading new one. Leave other Drive files untouched.
Excel formatting: PE-backed = red highlight, TOP tier = green, brokers = orange, zebra stripes, frozen headers, auto-filters
Contact targeting varies by company size: Large = VP Corp Dev, Medium = Division Head, Small = CEO/Founder, PE = Operating Partner, Aggregators = VP Acquisitions
PE-backed companies are highest priority — faster decision-making, higher acquisition appetite
6-touch outreach sequence over 30 days. TOP tier gets all 6 + Tim's custom first line. WEAK tier gets 3 emails only.
Never use markdown tables in emails — use bullet lists with bold labels
Skip Chinese Amazon sellers with no web presence
Supabase is single source of truth — HubSpot deprecated
Friend's Excel: only ADD columns/tabs, never change existing data. Strict quality filtering.
DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) must be configured before any email outreach
